name: 9-card Brag
description: 9-card Brag: nine cards each; make three three-card Brag hands (front, middle, back). Back must beat middle, middle must beat front. Same ranks as 3-card Brag. UK.

rules.objective: Arrange nine cards into three Brag hands of three (front, middle, back) so that back beats middle and middle beats front. Best valid layout wins.
rules.gameplay: Deal nine cards each. Each player arranges into three hands of three. Showdown: compare back vs back, middle vs middle, front vs front (Brag ranks: prial, run, flush, pair, high).
keyRules: Nine cards, three hands of three
Back must beat middle, middle must beat front
Brag hand ranks (prial, run, flush, pair)

strategy.basic: Put strongest hand in back, weakest in front; balance middle.
strategy.intermediate: Balance three hands; avoid invalid layouts (back ≤ middle ≤ front).
strategy.advanced: Bluff with weak-looking front; read opponents' structures.
tips: Nine cards into three hands of 3; Brag rankings.
Back must beat middle, middle must beat front.
